Message:
“Loki, there is something
I would like to ask of you.”

“You want me to
read your fate, don’t you.”

Ever since the day
I began the Witch Hunt,
I have been avoiding Loki...
believing that she surely
resented me...

And yet...Loki treats me
in the same manner
as she always had.

“You always come to me
seeking a reading in order to
save others—never yourself.

If this means that the
ever benevolent Elfriede
has lost her way,
I’ll be more than happy to help.”

After saying those words
with a smile, Loki began
laying out her tarot cards.

But, her hands froze upon
unveiling the final one.

“...My tarot cards...
won’t reveal your fate to me?

I’m sorry... This has
never happened before...”

“That is perfectly fine.
Thank you, Loki.
Hearing those words from you
has put my mind at ease.”
Loki is a brilliant fortune teller.

If even she cannot read my fate,
then the future that awaits me
must be shrouded in
the deepest darkness.

Thank goodness.
So I truly will...fall into Hell.
